fidelity: Adapted protocol prompts, not native framework installations; no adoption ranking is claimed.

profiles.prompt: Inspect the source, implement the request, run adequate checks and report the result.
Write a failing behavioral test for the requested change and run it. Make the smallest change that passes. Refactor only if needed and run regression tests.
Write a short specification and acceptance checks, then an implementation plan and task list. Implement the tasks and verify the acceptance checks.
Write a change proposal, explicit behavior delta, design and implementation tasks. Apply the tasks, verify the delta and record final verification.
Use a lightweight analyst, architect, developer and reviewer sequence in this single session. Record requirements, design, implementation and review. Scale artifacts to this task.
Clarify the design from the complete request, write a small plan, use red-green-refactor tests, review the change and verify it before completion. Do not delegate.

State the complete user promise, observable obligations, scoped paths and smallest adequate observer. Search only for a named gap. Implement only that scope, prove the user promise including failure cases, and retain failures and missing observers explicitly.
